text: dsh-reload-buttons 是面向 DSH web 界面的插件，会在会话头部左侧加入刷新界面和重启应用按钮。刷新时先检查客户端插件清单中的资源是否仍可用：可用时重载页面，清单过期时从宿主获取当前插件图并就地同步条目。重启按钮通过宿主路由执行操作；桌面端由独立脚本关闭界面壳并重新启动应用，web 模式则结束内核进程。适合需要在修改插件或配置后快速刷新界面、或重启 DSH 的用户。无需额外 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-reload-buttons adds reload and restart buttons to the DSH conversation header. Reload refreshes the page when client bundles are available, or syncs entries from the host when stale. Restart relaunches the desktop app or ends the web kernel. No API key or external service is needed.
修改客户端插件后，希望不用重启整个 DSH 就能刷新当前界面。
DSH 页面显示的插件版本可能过期时，想让界面重新同步最新插件清单。
I want a quick way to restart DSH after changing its configuration.
dsh-reload-buttons 的「刷新界面」功能：点击会先探测当前客户端插件 bundle；仍可用时重载页面，清单过期时改为按宿主当前插件图就地同步条目，并显示结果提示。
dsh-reload-buttons 的「重启应用」功能：点击并确认后会请求宿主重启路由；桌面端关闭应用界面壳并重新拉起程序，web 模式结束内核进程。
dsh-reload-buttons README · dsh-reload-buttons： **中文** | [English](README.en.md) 在 DSH 界面左上角放两个图标按钮：**刷新界面**、**重启应用**。改完插件或配置不用再手动关掉整个应用。

dsh-reload-buttons README · 两个按钮各自做什么：| 按钮 | 桌面端 | `dsh web` |
|---|---|---|
| 刷新 | 清单没过期 → 整页重载；清单过期 → 就地按宿主当前图对齐客户端插件，不重载、不关应用 | 同左 |
| 重启 | 关掉界面壳（Electron 主进程）→ 内核随 IPC 断开优雅收尾 → 独立脚本把 exe 拉起来，起不来再试一次 | 结束内核进程，重开交给你的启动方式 |

dsh-reload-buttons README · 刷新为什么分两路：桌面端重载页面用的是**内核启动那一刻**拍的客户端插件清单快照（主进程只认那一份）。改过客户端插件后，快照里的 bundle 地址已经 404，整页重载就是白屏加恢复框。

按钮的做法：先探一遍快照里的 bundle 是否都还取得到。全都取得到就真重载；取不到就改为就地重同步——从宿主 `/plugins/events` 首帧取当前图，用 `entries.sync` 对齐客户端插件条目，成功时不提示、不关应用（重同步本身失败才会提示改用「重启」）。彻底重来仍走「重启」。
dsh-reload-buttons README · 重启为什么先关界面壳：桌面端把内核退出一律当致命故障：内核自己 exit，主进程会弹「应用无法使用」。反过来，Electron 主进程一消失，内核的 IPC 断开会触发它自己的优雅收尾，此时也没有进程能弹框；随后独立脚本把 exe 重新拉起。
section: 重启为什么先关界面壳

text:
dsh-reload-buttons README · 安装：```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:taoziliyouchong/dsh-reload-buttons
```

发布到 npm 之后也可以：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-reload-buttons
```

装完重启 DSH。用别的 profile 就把 `desktop` 换成你的 profile 名。

要求：DSH 桌面端（重启按钮要关壳重开）。`dsh web` 下刷新可用，重启等于结束内核进程。Node 版本跟随 DSH，不需要额外运行时。

兼容：DSH 0.2.1 系列（alpha / rc / 正式版均可）；0.3 起不保证。

dsh-reload-buttons README · 界面位置：按钮挂在会话头部最左的 `conversation.header.leading`——一个 single 槽，当前由本插件占用。同优先级二次注册会抛错，不能和同样占这个座位的插件一起装。要换位置见 `src/entry.jsx` 顶部注释（`conversation.session.header.utilities` 是 list 槽）。

dsh-reload-buttons README · 机制：- 宿主半边注册一条 `POST /dsh-reload-buttons/api/restart`：只接受回环地址（`127.*`、`::1`、`::ffff:127.*`），只接受 POST。远程访问的 DSH 上点重启会被 403 拒绝。
- 桌面端把重启交棒给 `assets/restart-app.mjs`（detached spawn）：等 1.2 秒让 HTTP 响应交回浏览器 → 关掉 Electron 主进程 → 等端口释放（12 秒不放就结束内核）→ 拉起 exe 并按新进程 pid 探活（8 秒不稳就再试一次）。
- 桌面端每次启动端口都不同，探活只看进程 pid，不看端口。
- 重启日志写在 `$DSH_HOME/logs/dsh-reload-buttons-restart.log`。
- 刷新按钮是纯浏览器侧行为，不需要宿主。
- 不联网、不上传任何内容。

dsh-reload-buttons README · 已知限制：- 非桌面端没有界面壳可关，重启按钮只结束进程，重开取决于你的启动方式。
- 重启时界面会关掉，几秒后自动回来；若同时弹出带「重启」按钮的恢复框，点它也可以。
- 只对单机有效：回环地址以外的请求不处理。

dsh-reload-buttons README · 开发：源码分两半：

- `index.js` —— 宿主半边（路由、交棒、退出）
- `src/entry.jsx` —— 浏览器半边（两个按钮、刷新自检、就地重同步）

改过 `src/entry.jsx` 必须重新打包。`lib/client.js` 是提交进仓库的构建产物，缺了它界面不会加载：

```sh
npm install
npm run build:client    # 重新生成 lib/client.js
npm run check:client    # 比对新产物与已提交产物是否一致
npm run smoke           # 结构 / 注册 / 鉴权 / 产物 四关

打包要求：`react` 与 `react/jsx-runtime` 保持 external（由 DSH 客户端模块表提供）；产物外壳 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` 里的 `id` 必须等于包名。

dsh-reload-buttons README · 反馈：插件有问题，按这个顺序：

1. 开 Issue：https://github.com/taoziliyouchong/dsh-reload-buttons/issues —— 能留痕、能搜历史，别人也可能已经遇过；
2. 急着问或不想开 Issue，QQ 号：**2171960697**（加好友请注明装的是哪个插件）。

反馈时带上：DSH 版本、插件版本、报错原文、截图。少一样多半要再问一轮。

dsh-reload-buttons README · dsh-reload-buttons： [中文](README.md) | **English** Two icon buttons in the top-left corner of the DSH header: **reload the UI** and **restart the app**. No more closing the whole application by hand after changing a plugin or a config.

dsh-reload-buttons README · What each button does：| Button | Desktop app | `dsh web` |
|---|---|---|
| Reload | Manifest still valid → full page reload; manifest stale → re-align client plugins in place against the host's current graph, no reload, no closing the app | Same |
| Restart | Close the shell (the Electron main process) → the kernel shuts down cleanly when its IPC disconnects → a detached script relaunches the exe, retrying once if it does not stay up | End the kernel process; bring-up is up to your process manager |

dsh-reload-buttons README · Why reload has two paths：On the desktop app, a page reload uses the client-plugin manifest **snapshotted when the kernel started** — the main process only knows that copy. After a client plugin changes, the bundle URLs in that snapshot 404, so a full reload ends in a blank page plus a recovery dialog.

dsh-reload-buttons README · Why reload has two paths：The button therefore probes every bundle in the snapshot first: if all of them still resolve, it reloads; if not, it re-aligns the client plugin entries in place — it takes the current graph from the first frame of the host's `/plugins/events` and calls `entries.sync`, without any prompt and without closing the app (only a failed re-sync tells you to use Restart). A full teardown still goes through Restart.

dsh-reload-buttons README · Why restart closes the shell first：The desktop app treats any kernel exit as a fatal failure: if the kernel exits on its own, the main process shows the "app is unusable" dialog. The other direction works — once the Electron main process is gone, the kernel's IPC disconnect triggers its own graceful shutdown, and nothing is left to show a dialog; the detached script then relaunches the exe.
section: Why restart closes the shell first

text:
dsh-reload-buttons README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:taoziliyouchong/dsh-reload-buttons
```

Once published to npm, this also works:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-reload-buttons
```

Restart DSH afterwards. Replace `desktop` with your own profile name if you use another one.

dsh-reload-buttons README · Install：Requirements: the DSH desktop app (the restart button needs the shell to close and relaunch). On `dsh web` the reload button works and restart just ends the kernel process. Node follows DSH; no extra runtime is needed.

Compatible with the DSH 0.2.1 line (alpha / rc / stable); 0.3 and later are not guaranteed.

dsh-reload-buttons README · Where the buttons live：They are mounted at `conversation.header.leading` — the left-most slot of the conversation header, a `single` slot currently owned by this plugin. Registering the same slot twice at the same priority throws, so this plugin cannot be installed alongside another one that claims that exact slot. To move them, see the comment at the top of `src/entry.jsx` (`conversation.session.header.utilities` is a `list` slot).

dsh-reload-buttons README · How it works：- The host half registers `POST /dsh-reload-buttons/api/restart`: loopback addresses only (`127.*`, `::1`, `::ffff:127.*`) and POST only. On a DSH reachable from other machines, the restart call is rejected with 403.
- On the desktop app the restart is handed to `assets/restart-app.mjs` (detached spawn): wait 1.2 s so the HTTP response reaches the browser → close the Electron main process → wait for the port to be released (kill the kernel if it is not, after 12 s) → launch the exe and watch its new process pid (retry once if it does not stay up for 8 s).
- The desktop app uses a different port on every start, so liveness is checked by process pid, never by port.
- The restart log is written to `$DSH_HOME/logs/dsh-reload-buttons-restart.log`.
- The reload button is purely client-side; it needs no host support.
- No network access, nothing uploaded.

dsh-reload-buttons README · Known limits：- Non-desktop installs have no shell to close: restart only ends the kernel process, and bringing it back depends on how you start it.
- The window closes during a restart and comes back a few seconds later. If a recovery dialog with a "Restart" button shows up at the same time, using it works too.
- Local only: requests from anything other than loopback are not handled.

dsh-reload-buttons README · Development：The source has two halves:

- `index.js` — host side (route, hand-off, shutdown)
- `src/entry.jsx` — browser side (the two buttons, the reload probes, the in-place re-sync)

Editing `src/entry.jsx` requires rebuilding. `lib/client.js` is a build artifact committed to the repository; without it the UI does not load:

dsh-reload-buttons README · Development：```sh
npm install
npm run build:client    # regenerate lib/client.js
npm run check:client    # verify the committed artifact matches the source
npm run smoke           # structure / registration / authorization / artifact

Build rules: keep `react` and `react/jsx-runtime` external (the DSH client module table provides them); the `id` inside the `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` envelope must equal the package name.

dsh-reload-buttons README · Feedback：- Open an issue: https://github.com/taoziliyouchong/dsh-reload-buttons/issues — searchable, and others can help.
- Or reach me on QQ: **2171960697** (mention which plugin you installed when adding the contact).

Please include: DSH version, plugin version, the exact error text, and a screenshot.
